title: `createURL` always returns root/empty url on first render
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

`createURL` produces incorrect URLs on the server (it's always root URL).
The same applies to standard components from `react-instantsearch-hooks-web`: `Pagination`, etc.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. Fork \[[SSR example with Remix](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/react-instantsearch-hooks/remix?file=/app/routes/index.tsx)
2. Edit `app/root.tsx` and comment out `<Scripts />`
3. Refresh the page and inspect the `href`s of pagination links (`.ais-Pagination-link`)

**Live reproduction:**

https://codesandbox.io/s/zen-cache-7cyfjo?file=/app/root.tsx

## 💭 Expected behavior

`createURL` should produce correct URLs when server rendering, without running any code on the client.

## 🖥 Screenshots

## Environment

* React InstantSearch Hooks version: 6.38.1
* React version: 17.0.2
* Browser: Chrome
* OS: MacOS

## Additional context
